data.one_liner: Display numbers with a sliding animation.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a single widget, NumberSlideAnimation, which displays a number string using a neat sliding animation. You can configure properties such as the animation duration, curve, and text style.
use_when: You want a simple sliding transition animation for number displays
You need a neat intro animation for numbers in your application
avoid_when: You need to set a custom delay for each individual number
You need a delayed start mechanism out of the box
strengths: Very easy to set up and use
weaknesses: Lacks built-in functionality for setting a custom delay per number or a delayed start

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive and highly customizable animation system for any widget, including text and numbers.

data.minimal_example:
NumberSlideAnimation(
  number: "12345678987654321",
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
  curve: Curves.bounceIn,
  textStyle: TextStyle(
    fontSize: 20.0,
    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold
  ),
)
